what: a headline revealed word by word from behind a mask, then still
use_when: one short, strong headline carries the scene and the words themselves are the picture
avoid_when: the scene has a number, a list or a picture to show; the words need longer than one breath
rules: a "kinetic" scene shows 1-3 lines (each at most 40 characters) or one "text" of up to 180 characters, split into at most 3 lines; the words come in one after another, about five frames apart, and then stay still;
use it for the sentence that deserves to be read slowly, not for facts that need a number or a list.
